entities.summary: Johannes Heggland was a Norwegian novelist, short story and children's literature writer, playwright, and elected official with the Centre Party. He is most commonly associated with two of his historic plays Mostraspelet and Håkonarspelet – Kongen med gullhjelmen. Johannes Heggland was a authors & novelists from Tysnes Municipality (1919-06-29, Tysnes Municipality–2008-01-24). A moderately significant entity in the historical record.
